features.description: Damage spreading: Hamming fraction between a run and a copy with the centre cell flipped, averaged over the window (a Lyapunov-like spreading rate).
features.name: damage

features.description: zlib (level 9) size over raw size of the bit-packed window: ~1 is incompressible, ~0 is trivial.
features.name: compression

features.description: Mean fraction of live cells over the window.
features.name: density

features.description: Mean fraction of cells that change per step over the window.
features.name: activity

features.description: Shannon entropy of length-3 spatial blocks over the window, divided by 3.
features.name: block_entropy

features.description: Smallest p <= 64 such that the last row equals the row p steps earlier shifted by some s in [-p, p]; 0 if none (aperiodic). Mode over trials.
features.name: period
